fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-11-03 states that a rented premises near Sevvanthi Park Shopping Complex in Tiruppur was allegedly occupied by a person after the lease ended, and the keys were not returned, on 2025-10-28 around 16:00 hrs. Contact details given by the complainant, Inban Balan, include the number 9000000367. Another person, Rakesh Muthu, using the number 9000000045, was named as potentially involved. A further person, Mathan Raman, a co-worker, using the number 9000000187, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complaint mentions Logesh Subramani, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000233, in connection with the events. Pandian Balan (9000000285) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement and digital documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00251, as the mobile number 9000000233 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Occupant reportedly refused to vacate despite repeated requests.
